It sounds exhausting and unsettling to never know what to expect when you walk through the door, and it's clear you care deeply about Carol and your marriage.

The fact that her mood swings have become more frequent and severe is worth paying attention to. Changes like this can have many causes—hormonal shifts, stress, sleep problems, or underlying mental health conditions—and a good first step is encouraging her to see her doctor for an evaluation. You might frame it gently, focusing on how much you love her and want her to feel better, rather than on the behaviors themselves.

You don't have to carry this alone, either. Couples or individual counseling could give both of you tools and support. And if you ever notice signs she may harm herself or become unsafe, please treat that as urgent and reach out to a crisis line or emergency services right away. What made the hair-dyeing moment stand out most to you?
